note: Both sets capture the same core facts (module A/B overall lengths 12'-3 3/4" and 10'-3 3/4", the L3X3X1/4 angles, the 3/8" through bolts, and the three module-B dimensions), and both share the same defects: the 5/8" dimension is misread as 5/16" and misbound as a bolt type, S-301 (a detail reference) is recorded as a condition, and the three dimensions are left under the vague entity 'PV Detail'. Set B additionally binds L3X3X1/4 to the Module A member profile, which Set A omits, but it also repeats the 3/8" through-bolt claim and carries a bare 'S-301' fragment with no attribute or value. Set A is the cleaner, more faithful set overall; its only real gap (Module A member profile) is partly covered by the shared angle-size claim, whereas B's extras are duplicate/trivial noise.
remarks: Text layer lists '5/8"' in both detail blocks; both extractions report 5/16" and bind it to 'bolt type', which is likely both a misread and a misbound dimension (the through bolt is separately called out as 3/8"). The three dimensions 3'-8 3/8", 3'-6", 3'-1 5/16" belong to the C1 / Module B detail but neither set binds them to a component. Many page dimensions (e.g. 2'-2 7/8", 6 3/16", 1'-8 11/16", 4 13/16", 2'-3 7/8", 7'-0", 2'-11 7/8") are omitted by both sets.
